insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent limits are specified in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table, not in the wording itself. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room is chosen.

icu.note: ICU charges covered up to limits in Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table; proportionate deductions not applicable for ICU.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: Maternity expenses capped at ₹40,000 per event (normal delivery) and ₹60,000 per event (C-section), inclusive of newborn, vaccination and stem cell preservation. Other benefits up to SI per Policy Schedule.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the policy wording.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period as per Policy Schedule; reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list of specific diseases/procedures (cataract, hernia, arthritis, stones, etc.) excluded for 24 months from inception.

maternity.display: Covered (36mo wait); ₹40k normal / ₹60k C-section per event
maternity.note: Inbuilt cover after 36 months continuous coverage; max 2 lifetime events; includes newborn expenses, vaccination and stem cell preservation within maternity SI. Optional add-on reduces wait to 24 months.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonus at 10% of SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Optional Super NCB add-on can provide additional up to 100% on top (reduced by 50% SI on claim).

restoration.note: Binge Refill restores full SI unlimited times per policy year for any illness/injury including same illness; applies from first claim; refill SI not counted for NCB calculation.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days specified in Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for number of days specified in Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered up to SI; OPD treatment excluded.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered if continuing for at least 3 consecutive days and medically necessary. Home Treatment also covered via empanelled providers on cashless basis.

ayush.note: AYUSH in-patient hospitalisation and day care covered up to SI at AYUSH hospitals/day care centres; outpatient and treatment outside India excluded.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to limits in Policy Schedule; screening, pre/post-hosp of donor, and complications from harvesting excluded.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered for emergency transport to hospital or inter-hospital transfer; limit specified in Policy Schedule. Domestic emergency air ambulance also available under assistance service.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stereotactic radiosurgery, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, etc.) covered under in-patient or day care up to SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses (Annexure I items) are excluded by default. Optional 'Non-Medical Expense Waiver' cover (Section C.IV.w) covers these up to base SI.

global_cover.note: Territorial jurisdiction clause restricts all benefits to India only; treatment outside India is a specific exclusion.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for quarterly/half-yearly/annual premium; 15 days for monthly premium mode.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from receipt of policy document for new individual policies; not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability available; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/Hyperbaric O2/KTP laser/Cyber knife, external congenital anomalies, stem cell therapy (except haematopoietic BMT)

optional_riders.display: Super NCB, Travel Protect (domestic), Premium Waiver (CI/PTD), EMI Protection, Non-Medical Expense Waiver, Reduced Maternity Wait (24mo), OPD Expenses
